## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(bmm)
library(brms)
library(tidyverse)
library(tidybayes)
library(here)

source(here("_common.R"))  # shared workshop colors + ggplot theme
```

## Data

<!-- TODO (Gidon): add the real recognition-memory dataset. Document every

All columns are documented in the codebook: `data/README.md`.

```{r}
#| label: data
#| eval: false
dat <- read.csv(here("data", "sdt_recognition.csv"))
glimpse(dat)
```

## Load the fitted model

All workshop models ship pre-fitted in `models/` — nothing to compile,
nothing to wait for:

<!-- TODO (Gidon): once sdt_binary.rds is committed, remove `eval: false`
     here and in the chunks below so the rendered notebook shows the full
     worked analysis. -->

```{r}
#| label: load-fit
#| eval: false
fit_sdt <- readRDS(here("models", "sdt_binary.rds"))
```
